title: Fellowes Everyday Adjustable Dual Monitor Arm – Holds Two Screens up to 32" (inch) Weighing 19.84 lbs Each, Tilt, Swivel, Rotate, VESA 75/100, Clamp or Grommet Mount, Cable Management
features: DUAL SCREEN WORKING: Raise your screens to eye level to reduce neck strain. Holds two screens up to 32” & 19.84 lbs each. Provides flexible set up and increases productivity. Ideal for working, gaming or browsing the web.

HEIGHT AND DEPTH ADJUSTABLE: Position the top of your screens at eye level and at arms reach for ergonomic viewing. 16.02" pole offers 13" of height adjustment range. Arm measures 15.28" from the desk top to the middle of the VESA plate and extends to a maximum 15.87" for personalized screen positioning.

EASY INSTALLATION: Maximize desk space with 2 secure and easy installation methods. Simply clamp to desks .39" - 3.35" thick. Alternatively bolt through desk grommets .39" - 2.36" wide on desks .39" - 1.57" thick.

FULLY ADJUSTABLE: +/- 45° tilt (up & down) to reduce screen glare. View in portrait or landscape mode with 360° screen rotation. Easily collaborate with colleagues or friends with 180° arm swivel and +/-90° screen pan (left to right)
INTEGRATED CABLE MANAGEMENT: Keeps cables tidy and workspaces clutter-free with built-in hidden cable management system. Tool storage clip keeps allen keys handy for easy monitor arm adjustments.
